# mooncake snapshot

Print a compact machine state snapshot

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |
| `--budget` | int | `0` | Approximate token budget for text output (0 = unlimited, 1 token ≈ 4 chars) |
| `--diff` | string | - | Path to previous snapshot JSON file to diff against |
| `--save` | string | - | Save current snapshot to this file |
